## Security & Quality Checklist / Güvenlik ve Kalite Kontrol Listesi
- [ ] No `.env`, `.env.local`, or secret keys are included in this PR.
- [ ] Multi-tenant isolation (RLS) and role-based access rules (`organization_admin`, `laundry_staff`, `resident`) are preserved.
- [ ] Estimated (`software`) and user-reported (`user_report`) states are labeled honestly.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` pass in `apps/admin`.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass in `apps/mobile`.
